passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: This Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and notes thereto, which appear elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. This discussion may contain forward-looking statements based upon current expectations that involve risks and uncertainties. Our actual results may differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of various factors, including those set forth under the caption “Risk Factors” or in other parts of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The following section generally discusses our financial condition and results of operations for our fiscal year ended November 2, 2025 (“fiscal year 2025”) compared to our fiscal year ended November 3, 2024 (“fiscal year 2024”). A discussion regarding our financial condition and results of operations for fiscal year 2024 compared to our fiscal year ended October 29, 2023 can be found in Part II, Item 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for fiscal year 2024, filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) on December 20, 2024. Overview We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and semiconductor-based solutions and infrastructure software solutions. Our semiconductor and semiconductor-based solutions include a broad portfolio of complex digital and mixed signal devices based on silicon wafers with complementary metal oxide semiconductor transistors, III-V based devices, network interface cards and other modules, switches, subsystems and, in some cases, racks. Our solutions are used in a wide array of environments, end products and applications, such as enterprise and artificial intelligence (“AI”) data centers, servers and networking and connectivity equipment, as well as storage systems, home connectivity devices, set-top boxes, broadband access, telecommunication equipment, wireless devices and base stations, factory automation, power generation and alternative energy systems, and electronic displays. Our infrastructure software solutions help enterprises simplify their information technology environments. Our customers rely on our infrastructure and security software solutions to modernize, optimize, and secure the most complex private cloud, hybrid cloud and edge environments. This enables scalability, agility, automation, insights, resiliency and security, making it easy for customers to run their mission-critical workloads. We also offer mission-critical fibre channel storage area networking (“FC SAN”) products and related software in the form of modules, switches and subsystems incorporating multiple semiconductor products. We have two reportable segments: semiconductor solutions and infrastructure software. Our semiconductor solutions segment includes all of our semiconductor-based product lines and intellectual property (“IP”) licensing. Our infrastructure software segment includes our private cloud, mainframe software, cybersecurity and enterprise software portfolios, and our FC SAN business. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: Our business, operations and financial results are subject to various risks and uncertainties, including those described below, that could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and the trading price of our common stock. The following material factors, among others, could cause our actual results to differ materially from historical results and those expressed in forward-looking statements made by us or on our behalf in filings with the SEC, press releases, communications with investors and oral statements. Additional risks, trends and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently believe are immaterial may also harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, our reputation or the trading price of our common stock. Risk Factors Summary The following is a summary of the material risks that could adversely affect our business, operations and financial results. Risks Related to Our Business • Adverse global economic conditions could have a negative effect on us. • Our business is subject to various governmental regulations and trade restrictions. • Global political and economic conditions and other factors related to our international operations could adversely affect us. • We operate in a highly cyclical semiconductor industry that is undergoing profound change due to AI. • A significant reduction in demand or loss of one or more of our significant customers may adversely affect us. • A slow or the unsuccessful return on our investments in research and development, expansion of our business strategy or adoption of new business models could adversely affect us. • Winning business in the semiconductor solutions industry is an unpredictable process that often requires us to incur significant expenses, evolve our business strategy or adopt a new business model, which may negatively impact our results of operations, gross margin or cash flows. • Dependence on a limited number of contract manufacturers and suppliers of critical materials and components within our supply chain, and potential failure to adjust such manufacturing and supply chain to meet customer demand, may adversely affect our ability to bring products to market and our results of operations. • We are dependent on senior management and if we are unable to attract and retain qualified personnel, we may not be able to execute our business strategy effectively. • Our ability to maintain or improve gross margin. • Cybersecurity threats or credit_strengths.text: Operating margin expanded sharply year over year and now sits well above the sector median, reflecting pricing power across the semiconductor and infrastructure software portfolios and disciplined cost control through the AI-driven demand cycle.

Free cash flow covers dividends and buybacks combined with comfortable headroom, and operating cash flow similarly exceeds total shareholder distributions, so capital returns are funded internally rather than by incremental borrowing.

key_risks.text: Gross leverage sits above the sector median and net leverage is roughly double the sector median, so the balance sheet carries more gearing than technology peers despite the sharp year-over-year deleveraging from the prior acquisition-funded peak.

The risk factors flag a highly cyclical semiconductor industry undergoing profound change due to AI, plus customer concentration and dependence on a limited number of contract manufacturers, any of which could compress the cash flows that service the debt stack.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage improved markedly year over year and remains comfortably above unity, but it trails the sector median, and the debt maturity ladder concentrates the bulk of principal beyond year five, limiting near-term refinancing pressure.

Cash flow to debt improved year over year yet remains below the sector median, while the current ratio rose sharply and sits modestly below the peer median, indicating adequate but not leading liquidity against short-dated obligations.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is modest, with net leverage sitting below the next risk-band boundary and cash flow coverage above its threshold, though the leverage headroom is thin; a modest EBITDA decline or debt increase would push leverage into a weaker band.

Our judgement is a stable, investment-grade-like credit trajectory: strong margins and internally funded distributions support deleveraging, though above-median leverage and cyclical semiconductor demand argue for monitoring rather than aggressive releveraging.

credit_strengths.text: 營業利潤率按年大幅擴張，現時遠高於行業中位數，反映半導體及基礎設施軟件組合的定價能力，以及在AI驅動需求週期中嚴謹的成本控制。
自由現金流足以覆蓋股息與回購並有充裕緩衝，經營現金流同樣超過股東總分派，因此資本回報由內部資金支持，而非依賴新增借貸。

key_risks.text: 總槓桿高於行業中位數，淨槓桿約為行業中位數的兩倍，因此儘管較先前收購融資高峰按年大幅去槓桿，資產負債表的槓桿程度仍高於科技同業。
風險因素指出半導體行業高度週期性並因AI而經歷深刻變化，加上客戶集中及依賴少數代工製造商，任何一項均可能壓縮用於償付債務結構的現金流。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率按年顯著改善並仍穩居於一以上，但落後於行業中位數；債務到期階梯將大部分本金集中於五年之後，限制近期再融資壓力。
現金流對債務比率按年改善但仍低於行業中位數，而流動比率大幅上升並略低於同業中位數，顯示相對於短期債務的流動性充足但並非領先。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為溫和，淨槓桿低於下一個風險區間邊界，現金流覆蓋高於其門檻，惟槓桿緩衝薄弱；EBITDA小幅下降或債務增加將把槓桿推入較弱區間。
我們的判斷為穩定、類投資級的信用軌跡：強勁利潤率及內部資金支持的派息有助去槓桿，但高於中位數的槓桿及週期性半導體需求意味著應持續監察而非進取地重新加槓桿。
